verdict.line: You lose if you dump your burst into an unbaited W (Riposte) or let the fight drag long enough for her E (Burst of Speed) stacks to take over; you win if you tank her early Q (Lunge) pokes to fill W (Haymaker) Grit, then burst her down before she resets.

brief.thesis: Sett's W (Haymaker) converts every point of damage he takes into stored Grit, so absorbing Fiora's Lunge pokes before unloading the shield-and-burst combo flips her own aggression against her — which is why the data shows a 52.4% win rate over 2946 games with both lane and solo-kill advantage. The friction point is her W (Riposte) and double-charge Q (Lunge): commit an empowered auto into a parry or chase a dash you can't catch, and the trade reverses.

theirWindow.when: Riposte up, both Lunge charges ready
theirWindow.what: She can parry your Q-empowered right punch for free magic damage back and still has a dash in reserve to disengage. Throw a plain auto or let a minion eat the parry before committing your burst window.

yourWindow.when: W (Haymaker) at full Grit, both Lunges spent
yourWindow.what: Once she's burned her second Lunge charge she has no gap-close or escape left for a couple seconds. Dump W for the shield and true damage, land Q's empowered autos, and E (Facebreaker) if a minion or wall puts her on the opposite side for the stun instead of just a slow.

start.why: The highest-pickrate start (81.6%, 52.1% WR) gives the sustain and auto damage you need to tank early Lunge pokes while you wait for W Grit to fill.

boots.why: Picked in 73.1% of games at 50.9% WR — flattens the auto-reset chip damage from her Duelist passive stacking during extended exchanges.

core.why: Gives you the gap-close and slow needed to stick to her once she pops E (Burst of Speed) and tries to kite away.
Shreds her armor so your empowered Q autos and W burst keep scaling as the fight extends.
This path hits 61% WR over 482 games — the max-health damage and shield synergize with her high-HP duelist itemization.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the exact extended trades W (Haymaker) is built around, and the adaptive-force conversion to healing layers on top of your passive's missing-health regen.

summoners.why: Run by 95.1% of players at 52.3% WR — Ignite seals the all-in once you've landed W and E, and offsets the healing from her Duelist passive stacking mid-fight.

playing.title: Bait Riposte before committing
playing.detail: Throw a plain auto first to see if she parries. Leading with your Q-empowered right punch into an unbaited W (Riposte) wastes the burst window and hands her free magic damage back.

playing.title: Tank trades to fill Grit
playing.detail: W passively stores damage you take as Grit. Deliberately eat her Lunge and autos in short trades before levels 3-5 so you can dump the shield-and-true-damage burst on your terms.

playing.title: Position E for the stun, not the slow
playing.detail: E only stuns if enemies are on opposite sides of you; in open lane it just slows her. Line up a minion or wall behind her before casting to get the stun instead.

playing.title: Punish her second Lunge
playing.detail: Her Q can be used twice within a couple seconds for free, but once both charges are spent she has no gap-close or escape — that's your window to commit Q and E together.

playing.title: Hold R for an isolated slam
playing.detail: With a 120/100/80/80/80s cooldown, R is too valuable to open with. Use it after she's already extended on a Lunge so she lands away from minions and turret range.

playing.title: Keep trades short, not extended
playing.detail: Her E stacks attack speed and move speed per landed hit, so drawn-out auto exchanges favor her scaling. Burst with Q+W+E together, then disengage rather than standing in extended fights.

playing.title: Buy Bramble Vest if she snowballs
playing.detail: If her Duelist passive sustain is winning extended fights outright, pivot a core item slot into Bramble Vest before continuing the Stridebreaker/Cleaver path.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner picks are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade-pattern and timing reasoning is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Focus on avoiding Fiora’s (W) when using your abilities. Purchase Bramble Vest and be careful of her (P) when fighting her.
